items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: And Harry Carney and a couple of the other guys in the band are singing harmony.

ctx.x: Yes, sir. Sy Oliver started that. He was very much an instigator, and shaping that band. That's all I got to say about him.

Yeah, well, I think that had a -- because I know I've heard Ellington recording in which it seems as though they had heard -- Duke had heard that, there was a record called 'I Just Got To Be A Rug Cutter.' And Harry Carney and a couple of the other guys in the band are singing harmony.

Yeah, well, they got it from us. I won't say that's a true statement, but they were inspired by that Lunceford band. Man, we put on a show. And it was done simultaneously, just automatically created while he were playing. Now, we did rehearse the choral group, oh, yes, had to rehearse that. That was like playing.
